items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You know I’ve met some versatile musicians doing this projects, but you go from Louis Armstrong to James Brown.

ctx.x: You know I’ve met some versatile musicians doing this projects, but you go from Louis Armstrong to James Brown. I think that covers a lot of turf.
Yes it does, it really does.
